tbesh_html:
1) to withhold, restrain, hold back, keep in check, refrain
1a) (Qal)
1a1) to withhold, keep back, keep for oneself, keep from, hold in check, refrain, spare, reserve
1a2) to restrain, check
1b) (Niphal) to assuage, be spared

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to restrain or (reflex.) refrain; by implication, to refuse, spare, preserve; to observe
strongs_1890.derivation: a primitive root; also interchangeable  with H2821 (חָשַׁךְ)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: assuage, [idiom] darken, forbear, hinder, hold back, keep (back), punish, refrain, reserve, spare, withhold.
